prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, it was decided to proceed with a three-phase rollout, starting with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in the first two weeks of May, and a review before wider deployment. Key requirements include that the warehouse management system must remain on-premise and data must not breach security protocols, with an initial budget of up to $50,000 pending finance committee approval based on pilot results in June. Action items were assigned to update the schedule, confirm coordinators, and document technical requirements.
output_text: During the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, a three-phase rollout was approved, beginning with a discovery phase in April, a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, followed by a review before broader deployment.
